name: Wave Fixture AI
description: Automated Wave Soldering Pallet & Selective Solder Fixture CAM Engine
description_full: Wave Fixture AI turns your KiCad board into production-grade wave soldering pallet CAD drawings, watertight 3D models, and CNC G-code in seconds. Features 21 CAM automations, 3D component collision detection, 71 DRC manufacturing rules, and direct RS-274 G-code toolpath generation.
